overall_goal: Prepare and cook a bread omelet while logging ingredient weights

goals.rationale: The person washes their hands in the sink and dries them with a tablecloth to ensure hygiene before cooking.

goals.description: Record recipe details and prepare the weighing scale
goals.rationale: The person writes in a notebook and turns the weighing scale on and off to prepare for logging ingredients.
The person gets a spoon and spice bottles from the cabinet, then writes more ingredient details in the notebook.

goals.description: Season the eggs with salt and chilli powder
goals.rationale: The person adds salt and red chilli powder to the bowl of eggs to season the mixture.

goals.description: Return spices to the cabinet and get a spoon
goals.rationale: The person puts the spice bottles back into the cabinet and retrieves another spoon from the drawer.

goals.description: Add onions and mix the egg batter
goals.rationale: The person adds chopped onions to the eggs and mixes everything together to create the omelet batter.

goals.description: Weigh the bread and record its weight
goals.rationale: The person opens the bread packet, places slices on the scale, records the weight, and puts the bread aside.

goals.description: Retrieve butter and utensils for weighing
goals.rationale: The person gets the butter, places it on the chopping board, and retrieves a butter knife and spoon from the drawer.
The person prepares the scale, cuts a piece of butter, and places it on the spoon on the scale to measure it.

goals.description: Record the butter weight and adjust the scale
goals.rationale: The person wipes their hands, writes the butter's weight in the notebook, and makes final adjustments to the butter on the scale.

goals.description: Prepare the stove and melt butter in the pan
goals.rationale: The person turns on the gas, balances the pan, wipes their hands, turns on the chimney, and spreads the butter in the pan to melt.

goals.description: Cook the egg mixture with bread and prepare more butter
goals.rationale: The person pours the egg batter into the pan, adds a slice of bread, flips it, lowers the flame, and cuts more butter.
